allow: PowerShell($forks = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "https://api.github.com/repos/surajmeruva0786/orbissystems/forks" -Headers @{ "User-Agent" = "PowerShell" }; if \($forks.Count -eq 0\) { "No forks found." } else { $forks | Select-Object -ExpandProperty full_name })

hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && git add -A && if ! git diff --cached --quiet; then git commit -m "Update daily log $(date +%Y-%m-%d)" -q && git push origin main -q; fi
